moves.name: Absorb
moves.text: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Accelerock
moves.text: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Acid
moves.text: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Acid Armor
moves.text: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.text: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Acrobatics
moves.text: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the user has no held item, this move has double power.

moves.name: Acupressure
moves.text: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.
moves.desc:
Raises one of the target’s stats by two stages. The raised stat is chosen at random from any stats that can be raised by two stages. If no stat is eligible, this move will fail.

If the target has a Substitute, this move will have no effect, even if the user is the target.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.text: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Aeroblast
moves.text: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: After You
moves.text: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
moves.desc: The target will act next this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority. If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

moves.name: Agility
moves.text: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.text: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.text: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Alluring Voice
moves.text: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.text: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.desc: User switches position on the field with the friendly Pokémon opposite it. If the user is in the middle position in a triple battle, or there are no other friendly Pokémon, this move will fail.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.text: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Anchor Shot
moves.text: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.text: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

moves.name: Apple Acid
moves.text: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Lower the targets Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Aqua Cutter
moves.text: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.text: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.text: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.
moves.desc:
Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP at the end of each turn. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Aqua Step
moves.text: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.text: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Arm Thrust
moves.text: The user attacks the target with open-palmed arm thrusts. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Armor Cannon
moves.text: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Aromatherapy
moves.text: This move can't be used. It's recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can't be remembered.
moves.desc: Removes major status effects and confusion from every Pokémon in the user’s party.

moves.name: Aromatic Mist
moves.text: The user boosts the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
moves.desc: Raises a selected ally’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Assist
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Uses a move from another Pokémon in the user’s party, both selected at random. Moves from fainted Pokémon can be used. If there are no eligible Pokémon or moves, this move will fail.

This move will not select Assist, Chatter, Circle Throw, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dig, Dive, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Fly Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Phantom Force Protect, Quick Guard, Roar Shadow Force, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wide Guard.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Metronome or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.text: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the target takes damage this turn for any reason before this move is used, this move has double power.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.text: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Astral Barrage
moves.text: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Attack Order
moves.text: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Attract
moves.text: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.
moves.desc: Causes the target to fall in love with the user, giving it a 50% chance to do nothing each turn. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail. If either Pokémon leaves the field, this effect ends.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.text: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Aura Wheel
moves.text: Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.
moves.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage. In Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. In Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. Fails unless the user is Hangry Mode or Full Belly Mode Morpeko.

moves.name: Aurora Beam
moves.text: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Aurora Veil
moves.text: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only when it is snowing.
moves.desc: Places the Aurora Veil effect on the user’s side of the field for the next 5 turns. If the weather is not Hail, or the weather is disabled by the effects of Cloud Nine or Air Lock, this move will fail. Any regular damage dealt to an affected Pokémon is reduced by ½. (If there are multiple Pokémon on the affected field, the reduction is ⅓.)

moves.name: Autotomize
moves.text: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages. Halves the user’s weight; this effect does not stack.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.text: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power.

Pain Split does not count as damaging the user.

moves.name: Axe Kick
moves.text: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.text: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Baddy Bad
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Baneful Bunker
moves.text: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.
moves.desc: Grants the user protection for the rest of the turn. If a Pokémon attempts to use a move that makes contact with the user, that Pokémon will be poisoned. This move’s chance of success halves every time it’s used consecutively with any other protection move.

moves.name: Barb Barrage
moves.text: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

moves.name: Barrage
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Barrier
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.text: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.
moves.desc:
User switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. Stat changes, confusion, and persistent move effects are passed along to the replacement Pokémon.

The following move effects are passed:

* Aqua Ring * both the user’s and target’s effect of Block, Mean Look, and Spider Web * the curse effect of Curse * Embargo * Focus Energy or an activated Lansat Berry * Gastro Acid * Ingrain * being sapped by Leech Seed * being targeted by Lock-On or Mind Reader * Magnet Rise * Perish Song’s counter * Power Trick * Substitute; the doll’s HP is unchanged

The replacement Pokémon does not trigger effects that respond to Pokémon switching in.

moves.name: Beak Blast
moves.text: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the user while it's heating up its beak results in a burn.
moves.desc: Begins charging at the start of the turn, then attacks as normal. Any Pokémon that makes contact with the user while charging is burned. The charging is not affected by accuracy, sleep, paralysis, or any other effect that would interfere with a move.

moves.name: Beat Up
moves.text: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.
moves.desc:
Inflicts typeless regular damage. Every Pokémon in the user’s party, excepting those that have fainted or have a major status effect, attacks the target. Calculated stats are ignored; the base stats for the target and assorted attackers are used instead. The random factor in the damage formula is not used. Dark Pokémon still get STAB.

This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

moves.name: Behemoth Bash
moves.text: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
moves.desc: This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

moves.name: Behemoth Blade
moves.text: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
moves.desc: This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

moves.name: Belch
moves.text: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Can only be used if the user has eaten a berry since the beginning of the battle.

After the user eats a berry, it may use this move any number of times until the end of the battle, even if it switches out. Eating a held berry, eating a berry via Bug Bite or Pluck, or being the target of a Flung berry will enable this move. Feeding a Pokémon a berry from the bag or using Natural Gift will not.

If the trainer chooses this move when it cannot be used, the choice is rejected outright and the trainer must choose another move.

moves.name: Belly Drum
moves.text: The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.
moves.desc: User pays half its max HP to raise its Attack to +6 stages. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail.

moves.name: Bestow
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Transfers the user’s held item to the target. If the user has no held item, or the target already has a held item, this move will fail.

moves.name: Bide
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
User waits for two turns. On the second turn, the user inflicts twice the damage it accumulated on the last Pokémon to hit it. Damage inflicted is typeless.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Bind
moves.text: A long body, tentacles, or the like are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Bite
moves.text: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Bitter Blade
moves.text: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Bitter Malice
moves.text: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Blast Burn
moves.text: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Blaze Kick
moves.text: The user launches a kick that has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Bleakwind Storm
moves.text: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.text: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

During Hail, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

moves.name: Block
moves.text: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.
moves.desc:
The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field.

The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell.

Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

moves.name: Blood Moon
moves.text: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.

moves.name: Blue Flare
moves.text: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.text: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
moves.desc: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.text: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Bolt Beak
moves.text: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
moves.desc: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

moves.name: Bolt Strike
moves.text: The user surrounds itself with a great amount of electricity and charges the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Bone Club
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Bone Rush
moves.text: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Bonemerang
moves.text: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to hit the target twice—coming and going.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Boomburst
moves.text: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.text: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User bounces high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

During the immune turn, Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, and Twister still hit the user normally. Gust and Twister also have double power against the user.

The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during the immune turn.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Bouncy Bubble
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Branch Poke
moves.text: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.text: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Breaking Swipe
moves.text: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.text: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
moves.desc: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Brine
moves.text: This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has less than half its max HP remaining, this move has double power.

moves.name: Brutal Swing
moves.text: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Bubble
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.text: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.text: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.

If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.

If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.text: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.text: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.text: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.text: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.text: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Burn Up
moves.text: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the user’s Fire type after damage calculation. If the user is not Fire-type, this move will fail.

moves.name: Burning Bulwark
moves.text: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

moves.name: Burning Jealousy
moves.text: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.
moves.desc: Burns the target if it had a state stage raise this turn.

moves.name: Buzzy Buzz
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.text: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Camouflage
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
User’s type changes according to the terrain.

Terrain | New type -------------- | -------------- Building | Normal Cave | Rock Desert | Ground Grass | Grass Mountain | Rock Ocean | Water Pond | Water Road | Ground Snow | Ice Tall grass | Grass

In Pokémon Battle Revolution:

Terrain | New type -------------- | -------------- Courtyard | Normal Crystal | Rock Gateway | Water Magma | Rock Main Street | Normal Neon | Normal Stargazer | Rock Sunny Park | Grass Sunset | Ground Waterfall | Grass

moves.name: Captivate
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail.

moves.name: Ceaseless Edge
moves.text: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.

moves.name: Celebrate
moves.text: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!
moves.desc: Does nothing.

moves.name: Charge
moves.text: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage. If the user uses an Electric move next turn, its power will be doubled.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.text: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Charm
moves.text: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Chatter
moves.text: The user attacks the target with sound waves of deafening chatter. This confuses the target.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has either a 1%, 11%, or 31% chance to confuse the target, based on the volume of the recording made for this move; louder recordings increase the chance of confusion. If the user is not a Chatot, this move will not cause confusion.

This move cannot be copied by Mimic, Mirror Move, or Sketch, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Chilling Water
moves.text: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Chilly Reception
moves.text: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

moves.name: Chip Away
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

moves.name: Chloroblast
moves.text: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Circle Throw
moves.text: The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random.

If the target is under the effect of Ingrain or Suction Cups, or it has a Substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out. If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead.

moves.name: Clamp
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Clanging Scales
moves.text: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user's Defense stat is lowered after the attack.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Clangorous Soul
moves.text: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.
moves.desc: User loses 33% of its Max HP. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. Fails if the user would faint, or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed stat cannot go any higher.

moves.name: Clear Smog
moves.text: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. All of the target’s stat modifiers are reset to zero.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.text: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Coaching
moves.text: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.
moves.desc: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

moves.name: Coil
moves.text: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.

moves.name: Collision Course
moves.text: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

moves.name: Comet Punch
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Comeuppance
moves.text: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

moves.name: Confide
moves.text: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.text: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.
moves.desc: Confuses the target.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.text: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Constrict
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Conversion
moves.text: The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.
moves.desc: User’s type changes to the type of one of its moves, selected at random. Hidden Power and Weather Ball are treated as Normal. Only moves with a different type are eligible, and Curse is never eligible. If the user has no suitable moves, this move will fail.

moves.name: Conversion 2
moves.text: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the move the target used last.
moves.desc: Changes the user’s type to a type either resistant or immune to the last damaging move that hit it. The new type is selected at random and cannot be a type the user already is. If there is no eligible new type, this move will fail.

moves.name: Copycat
moves.text: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.
moves.desc:
Uses the last move that was used successfully by any Pokémon, including the user.

This move cannot copy itself, nor Roar nor Whirlwind.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Core Enforcer
moves.text: If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on have already used their moves, this move eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has already moved this turn, its ability is nullified.

moves.name: Corrosive Gas
moves.text: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle.

If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.

moves.name: Cosmic Power
moves.text: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Cotton Guard
moves.text: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.

moves.name: Cotton Spore
moves.text: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Counter
moves.text: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.
moves.desc:
Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a physical move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Court Change
moves.text: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.
moves.desc: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.

moves.name: Covet
moves.text: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken.

Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect.

The target cannot recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Crabhammer
moves.text: The target is hammered with a large pincer. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Crafty Shield
moves.text: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power. This does not stop moves that do damage.
moves.desc:
Protects all friendly Pokémon from non-damaging moves for the rest of the turn.

Unlike other blocking moves, this move may be used consecutively without its chance of success falling.

moves.name: Cross Chop
moves.text: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Cross Poison
moves.text: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.text: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Crush Claw
moves.text: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Crush Grip
moves.text: The target is crushed with great force. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.

moves.name: Curse
moves.text: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.
moves.desc:
If the user is a Ghost: user pays half its max HP to place a curse on the target, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP every turn. Otherwise: Lowers the user’s Speed by one stage, and raises its Attack and Defense by one stage each.

The curse effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Cut
moves.text: The target is cut with a scythe or claw.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.text: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Dark Void
moves.text: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that puts them to sleep.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Darkest Lariat
moves.text: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.text: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Decorate
moves.text: The user sharply boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.
moves.desc: Raise the targets Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.

moves.name: Defend Order
moves.text: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, boosting its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.text: The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.
moves.desc:
Raises user’s Defense by one stage.

After this move is used, the power of Ice Ball and Rollout are doubled until the user leaves the field.

moves.name: Defog
moves.text: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.
moves.desc:
Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage. Clears away fog. Removes the effects of Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Safeguard, Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the target’s side of the field.

If the target is protected by Mist, it will prevent the evasion change, then be removed by this move.

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.text: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.desc:
If the user faints before its next move, the Pokémon that fainted it will automatically faint. End-of-turn damage is ignored.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Detect
moves.text: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.desc:
No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail.

Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move.

Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move.

The following effects are not prevented by this move:

* Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Diamond Storm
moves.text: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage opposing Pokémon. This may also sharply boost the user's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense by two stages for each target hit.

moves.name: Dig
moves.text: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User digs underground for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, Earthquake, Fissure, and Magnitude still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Dire Claw
moves.text: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

moves.name: Disable
moves.text: For four turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.
moves.desc: Disables the target’s last used move, preventing its use for 4–7 turns, selected at random, or until the target leaves the field. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, or if it already has a move disabled, this move will fail.

moves.name: Disarming Voice
moves.text: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.text: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Dive
moves.text: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User dives underwater for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, Surf, and Whirlpool still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Dizzy Punch
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Doodle
moves.text: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

moves.name: Doom Desire
moves.text: Two turns after this move is used, a concentrated bundle of light blasts the target.
moves.desc:
Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn.

This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection.

The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.text: The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Double Iron Bash
moves.text: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Double Kick
moves.text: The user attacks by kicking the target twice in a row using two feet.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Double Shock
moves.text: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.

moves.name: Double Slap
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.text: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s evasion by one stage.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.text: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Draco Meteor
moves.text: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Dragon Ascent
moves.text: The user attacks the target by dropping out of the sky at high speed. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Dragon Breath
moves.text: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Dragon Cheer
moves.text: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.text: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Dragon Dance
moves.text: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage each.

moves.name: Dragon Darts
moves.text: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.
moves.desc: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.

moves.name: Dragon Energy
moves.text: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

moves.name: Dragon Hammer
moves.text: The user wields its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.text: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Dragon Rage
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts exactly 40 damage.

moves.name: Dragon Rush
moves.text: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Dragon Tail
moves.text: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random.

If the target is under the effect of Ingrain or Suction Cups, or it has a Substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out. If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.text: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.text: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.
moves.desc: Deals regular damage. Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.text: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.desc: Fails if not used on a sleeping Pokémon. Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Drill Peck
moves.text: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Drill Run
moves.text: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Drum Beating
moves.text: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Dual Chop
moves.text: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.text: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Dynamax Cannon
moves.text: The user condenses energy within its body and unleashes that energy from its core to inflict damage.
moves.desc: This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

moves.name: Dynamic Punch
moves.text: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.text: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.text: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is in the first turn of Dig, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: Echoed Voice
moves.text: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, its power is boosted.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If any friendly Pokémon used this move earlier this turn or on the previous turn, that use’s power is added to this move’s power, to a maximum of 200.

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.text: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Eerie Spell
moves.text: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.
moves.desc: The target loses 3 PP from the last move it used.

moves.name: Egg Bomb
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.text: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.
moves.desc:
For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power.

Changes Nature Power to Thunderbolt.

moves.name: Electrify
moves.text: If the target is electrified before it uses a move during that turn, the target’s move becomes Electric type.
moves.desc: Changes the target’s move’s type to Electric if it hasn’t moved yet this turn.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.text: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s Speed compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 150.

User’s Speed | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s Speed | 60 Up to 3× the target’s Speed | 80 Up to 4× the target’s Speed | 120 More than 4× the target’s Speed | 150

moves.name: Electro Drift
moves.text: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

moves.name: Electro Shot
moves.text: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.text: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Embargo
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Target cannot use its held item for five turns. If the target leaves the field, this effect ends.

If a Pokémon under this effect uses Bug Bite or Pluck on a Pokémon holding a berry, the berry is destroyed but not used. If a Pokémon under this effect uses Fling, it will fail.

This effect is passed by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Ember
moves.text: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Encore
moves.text: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.
moves.desc:
The next 4–8 times (selected at random) the target attempts to move, it is forced to repeat its last used move. If the selected move allows the trainer to select a target, an opponent will be selected at random each turn. If the target is prevented from using the selected move by some other effect, Struggle will be used instead. This effect ends if the selected move runs out of PP.

If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if it does not know the selected move, or if the selected move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail. If the target’s last used move was Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform, this move will fail.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.text: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.
moves.desc: Inflicts exactly enough damage to lower the target’s HP to equal the user’s. If the target’s HP is not higher than the user’s, this move has no effect. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This effect counts as damage for moves that respond to damage.

moves.name: Endure
moves.text: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.
moves.desc:
The user’s HP cannot be lowered below 1 by any means for the remainder of this turn.

If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.text: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Entrainment
moves.text: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.
moves.desc: Changes the target’s ability to match the user’s. This effect ends when the target leaves battle.

moves.name: Eruption
moves.text: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

moves.name: Esper Wing
moves.text: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Eternabeam
moves.text: This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.text: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.
moves.desc: If Psychic Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power incrased by 50%.

moves.name: Explosion
moves.text: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
moves.desc: User faints, even if the attack fails or misses. Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.text: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Extreme Speed
moves.text: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Facade
moves.text: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, this move has double power.

moves.name: Fairy Lock
moves.text: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
moves.desc: Prevents all Pokémon from fleeing or switching out during the next turn.

moves.name: Fairy Wind
moves.text: The user attacks by stirring up a fairy wind to strike the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.text: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Causes the target to flinch. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.text: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: False Surrender
moves.text: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: False Swipe
moves.text: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1.

moves.name: Feather Dance
moves.text: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Feint
moves.text: This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Removes the effects of Detect or Protect from the target before hitting.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Feint Attack
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Fell Stinger
moves.text: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat is boosted drastically.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Attack by two stages if it KOs the target.

moves.name: Fickle Beam
moves.text: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.

moves.name: Fiery Dance
moves.text: Cloaked in flames, the user attacks the target by dancing and flapping its wings. This may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Fiery Wrath
moves.text: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Fillet Away
moves.text: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

moves.name: Final Gambit
moves.text: The user risks everything to attack the target. The user faints but inflicts damage equal to its own HP.
moves.desc: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP. User faints.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.text: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Fire Fang
moves.text: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Fire Lash
moves.text: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Fire Pledge
moves.text: A column of fire hits the target. When used with its grass counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a vast sea of fire appears.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Water Pledge earlier this turn, moves used by any friendly Pokémon have doubled effect chance for four turns (including this one).

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.text: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.text: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: First Impression
moves.text: Although this move has great power, it works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.

moves.name: Fishious Rend
moves.text: The user rends the target with its hard gills. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
moves.desc: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

moves.name: Fissure
moves.text: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
moves.desc:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

moves.name: Flail
moves.text: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power varies inversely with the user’s proportional remaining HP.

64 * current HP / max HP | Power -----------------------: | ----: 0– 1 | 200 2– 5 | 150 6–12 | 100 13–21 | 80 22–42 | 40 43–64 | 20

moves.name: Flame Burst
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If this move successfully hits the target, any Pokémon adjacent to the target are damaged for 1/16 their max HP.

moves.name: Flame Charge
moves.text: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Flame Wheel
moves.text: The user attacks by cloaking itself in fire and charging at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.text: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.text: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot and may leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

moves.name: Flash
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.text: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Flatter
moves.text: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also boosts the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage, then confuses it.

moves.name: Fleur Cannon
moves.text: The user unleashes a strong beam. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Fling
moves.text: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held item. The item is consumed. If the user is not holding an item, or its item has no set type and power, this move will fail.

This move ignores Sticky Hold.

If the user is under the effect of Embargo, this move will fail.

moves.name: Flip Turn
moves.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

moves.name: Floaty Fall
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Floral Healing
moves.text: The user restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP. More HP is restored when the ground is Grassy Terrain.
moves.desc: Heals the target for ½ its max HP. If Grassy Terrain is in effect, heals for ⅔ instead.

moves.name: Flower Shield
moves.text: The user raises the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.
moves.desc: Raises the Defense of all Grass Pokémon in battle.

moves.name: Flower Trick
moves.text: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

moves.name: Fly
moves.text: The user flies up into the sky on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User flies high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, Twister, and Whirlwind still hit the user normally. Gust and Twister also have double power against the user.

The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during the immune turn.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Flying Press
moves.text: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the purposes of type effectiveness, this move is both Fighting- and Flying-type: its final effectiveness is determined by multiplying the effectiveness of each type against each of the target’s types.

For all other purposes, this move is pure Fighting-type. If this move’s type is changed, its Fighting typing is overwritten, and its secondary type remains Flying.

If the target has used Minimize since entering battle, this move has double power and will never miss.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.text: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.text: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that its future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits.
moves.desc:
User’s critical hit rate is two levels higher until it leaves the field. If the user has already used Focus Energy since entering the field, this move will fail.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.text: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the user takes damage this turn before hitting, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Follow Me
moves.text: The user draws attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user.
moves.desc:
Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target.

This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain.

If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Force Palm
moves.text: The target is attacked with a shock wave. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Foresight
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Forest’s Curse
moves.text: The user puts a forest curse on the target. This adds Grass type to the target's type.
moves.desc: Adds Grass to the target’s types.

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.text: The user turns the target's strength against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage this move inflicts.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Damage is calculated using the target’s attacking stat rather than the user’s.

moves.name: Freeze Shock
moves.text: The turn after using this move, the user hits the target with electrically charged ice to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. User charges for one turn before attacking.

moves.name: Freeze-Dry
moves.text: The user rapidly cools the target. This may also leave the target frozen. This move is super effective on Water types.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. This move is super-effective against the Water type.

The target’s other type will affect damage as usual. If this move’s type is changed, it remains super-effective against Water regardless of its type.

moves.name: Freezing Glare
moves.text: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

During Hail, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

moves.name: Freezy Frost
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Frenzy Plant
moves.text: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Frost Breath
moves.text: The user attacks by blowing its cold breath on the target. This move always lands a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases inversely with happiness, given by `(255 - happiness) * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1.

moves.name: Fury Attack
moves.text: The user attacks by jabbing the target with a horn, a beak, or the like. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Fury Cutter
moves.text: The user attacks by slashing the target with scythes, claws, or the like. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power doubles after every time this move is used, whether consecutively or not, maxing out at 16x. If this move misses or the user leaves the field, power resets.

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.text: The user attacks by raking the target with claws, scythes, or the like. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Fusion Bolt
moves.text: The user throws down a giant lightning bolt. This move's power is boosted when influenced by an enormous flame.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Fusion Flare earlier this turn, this move has double power.
