moves.name: Fusion Flare
moves.text: The user brings down a giant flame. This move's power is boosted when influenced by an enormous lightning bolt.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Fusion Bolt earlier this turn, this move has double power.

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.text: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.
moves.desc:
Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn.

This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection.

The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Gastro Acid
moves.text: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target's Ability.
moves.desc:
The target’s ability is disabled as long as it remains on the field.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Gear Grind
moves.text: The user attacks by throwing steel gears at its target twice.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Gear Up
moves.text: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.
moves.desc: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.

moves.name: Geomancy
moves.text: The user absorbs energy and sharply raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.
moves.desc: Takes one turn to charge, then raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.text: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.text: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Gigaton Hammer
moves.text: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.

moves.name: Glacial Lance
moves.text: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Glaciate
moves.text: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Speed stats.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Glaive Rush
moves.text: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

moves.name: Glare
moves.text: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.
moves.desc: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Glitzy Glow
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.text: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120.

Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120

moves.name: Grass Pledge
moves.text: A column of grass hits the target. When used with its water counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a vast swamp appears.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Fire Pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon will take 1/8 their max HP in damage at the end of every turn for four turns (including this one).

moves.name: Grass Whistle
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Grassy Glide
moves.text: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.
moves.desc: If Grassy Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its priority increased by 1.

moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.text: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.
moves.desc:
For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 their max HP each turn and strengthens their Grass moves to 1.5× their power.

Changes Nature Power to Energy Ball.

moves.name: Grav Apple
moves.text: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Lower the targets Defense by 1 stage. Damage is increased by 50% during Gravitys effect.

moves.name: Gravity
moves.text: Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.
moves.desc:
For five turns (including this one), all immunities to Ground moves are disabled. For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages. Cancels the effects of Bounce, Fly, and Sky Drop.

Specifically, Flying Pokémon and those with Levitate or that have used Magnet Rise are no longer immune to Ground attacks, Arena Trap, Spikes, or Toxic Spikes.

Bounce, Fly, Sky Drop, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, and Splash cannot be used while this move is in effect.

*Bug*: If this move is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of Sky Drop, Sky Drop’s effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely. As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

moves.name: Growl
moves.text: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Growth
moves.text: The user's body grows all at once, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each. During Sunny Day, raises both stats by two stages.

moves.name: Grudge
moves.text: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent’s move that knocked it out.
moves.desc: If the user faints before it next acts, the move that fainted it will have its PP dropped to 0. End-of-turn damage does not trigger this effect.

moves.name: Guard Split
moves.text: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of the target.
moves.desc: Averages the user’s unmodified Defense with the target’s unmodified Defense; the value becomes the unmodified Defense for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Defense is averaged the same way.

moves.name: Guard Swap
moves.text: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.
moves.desc: User swaps its Defense and Special Defense modifiers with the target.

moves.name: Guillotine
moves.text: A vicious tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
moves.desc:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.text: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Gust
moves.text: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.text: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.

moves.name: Hail
moves.text: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.
moves.desc:
Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-Ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn.

If the user is holding Icy Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Blizzard has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Blizzard has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP.

Pokémon with Snow Cloak are exempt from this effect’s damage.

moves.name: Hammer Arm
moves.text: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Happy Hour
moves.text: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.
moves.desc:
Doubles prize money.

Stacks with a held item. Only works once per battle.

moves.name: Hard Press
moves.text: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Harden
moves.text: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to boost its Defense stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Haze
moves.text: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
moves.desc:
Removes stat, accuracy, and evasion modifiers from every Pokémon on the field.

This does not count as a stat reduction for the purposes of Clear Body or White Smoke.

moves.name: Head Charge
moves.text: The user charges its head into its target, using its powerful guard hair. This also damages the user a little.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Head Smash
moves.text: The user attacks the target with a hazardous full-power headbutt. This also damages the user terribly.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/2 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.text: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Headlong Rush
moves.text: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Heal Bell
moves.text: The user makes a soothing bell chime to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.
moves.desc: Removes major status effects and confusion from every Pokémon in the user’s party.

moves.name: Heal Block
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: For the next five turns, the target may not use any moves that only restore HP, and move effects that heal the target are disabled. Moves that steal HP may still be used, but will only inflict damage and not heal the target.

moves.name: Heal Order
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Heal Pulse
moves.text: The user emits a healing pulse that restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP.
moves.desc: Heals the target for half its max HP.

moves.name: Healing Wish
moves.text: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status conditions cured.
moves.desc: User faints. Its replacement’s HP is fully restored, and any major status effect is removed. If the replacement Pokémon is immediately fainted by a switch-in effect, the next replacement is healed by this move instead.

moves.name: Heart Stamp
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Heart Swap
moves.text: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.
moves.desc: User swaps its stat modifiers with the target.

moves.name: Heat Crash
moves.text: The user slams into the target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120.

User’s weight | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s weight | 40 Up to 3× the target’s weight | 60 Up to 4× the target’s weight | 80 Up to 5× the target’s weight | 100 More than 5× the target’s weight | 120

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.text: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Heavy Slam
moves.text: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120.

User’s weight | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s weight | 40 Up to 3× the target’s weight | 60 Up to 4× the target’s weight | 80 Up to 5× the target’s weight | 100 More than 5× the target’s weight | 120

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.text: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.
moves.desc:
Boosts the power of the target’s moves by 50% until the end of this turn.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Hex
moves.text: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has a major status ailment, this move has double power.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s IVs.

Power is given by `x * 40 / 63 + 30`. `x` is obtained by arranging bit 1 from the IV for each of Special Defense, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, Attack, and HP in that order. (Bit 1 is 1 if the IV is of the form `4n + 2` or `4n + 3`. `x` is then 64 * Special Defense IV bit 1, plus 32 * Special Attack IV bit 1, etc.)

Power is always between 30 and 70, inclusive. Average power is 49.5.

Type is given by `y * 15 / 63`, where `y` is similar to `x` above, except constructed from bit 0. (Bit 0 is 1 if the IV is odd.) The result is looked up in the following table.

Value | Type ----: | -------- 0 | Fighting 1 | Flying 2 | Poison 3 | Ground 4 | Rock 5 | Bug 6 | Ghost 7 | Steel 8 | Fire 9 | Water 10 | Grass 11 | Electric 12 | Psychic 13 | Ice 14 | Dragon 15 | Dark

This move thus cannot be Normal. Most other types have an equal 1/16 chance to be selected, given random IVs. However, due to the flooring used here, Bug, Fighting, and Grass appear 5/64 of the time, and Dark only 1/64 of the time.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.text: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: High Jump Kick
moves.text: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If this move misses, is blocked by Protect or Detect, or has no effect, the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP rounded down.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

moves.name: Hold Back
moves.text: The user holds back when it attacks, and the target is left with at least 1 HP.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1.

moves.name: Hold Hands
moves.text: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.
moves.desc: Does nothing.

moves.name: Hone Claws
moves.text: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Horn Attack
moves.text: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Horn Drill
moves.text: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
moves.desc:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

moves.name: Horn Leech
moves.text: The user drains the target's energy with its horns. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Howl
moves.text: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.text: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This may also confuse the target.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop.

During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.

moves.name: Hydro Cannon
moves.text: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.text: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Hydro Steam
moves.text: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.text: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Hyper Drill
moves.text: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

moves.name: Hyper Fang
moves.text: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.text: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Hyperspace Fury
moves.text: Using its many arms, the user unleashes a barrage of attacks that ignore the effects of moves like Protect and Detect. This also lowers the user's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Bypasses and removes any protection effect on the target.

moves.name: Hyperspace Hole
moves.text: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Bypasses and removes any protection effect on the target.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.text: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Ice Ball
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for five turns. Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends. If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends.

If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.text: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

moves.name: Ice Burn
moves.text: The turn after using this move, the user surrounds the target with an ultracold, freezing wind to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. User charges for one turn before attacking.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.text: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Ice Hammer
moves.text: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.text: The target is attacked with an icy punch. This may also leave the target frozen.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.text: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Ice Spinner
moves.text: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

moves.name: Icicle Crash
moves.text: The user attacks by crashing large icicles onto the target. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Icicle Spear
moves.text: The user attacks by launching sharp icicles at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.text: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.text: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.
moves.desc: Prevents any Pokémon on the opposing side of the field from using any move the user knows until the user leaves the field. This effect is live; if the user obtains new moves while on the field, these moves become restricted. If no opposing Pokémon knows any of the user’s moves when this move is used, this move will fail.

moves.name: Incinerate
moves.text: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, it’s destroyed and cannot be used in response to this move.

moves.name: Infernal Parade
moves.text: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.name: Inferno
moves.text: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Infestation
moves.text: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.text: The user lays roots that restore its own HP every turn. Because the user is now rooted, it can't switch out.
moves.desc:
Prevents the user from switching out. User regains 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn. If the user was immune to Ground attacks, it will now take normal damage from them.

Roar and Whirlwind will not affect the user. The user cannot use Magnet Rise.

The user may still use U-turn to leave the field.

This effect can be passed with Baton Pass.

moves.name: Instruct
moves.text: The user instructs the target to reuse the move last used by the target.
moves.desc: The target immediately uses its most recently-used move. This is independent of the target’s normal action for the turn (i.e., it may end up moving twice), but otherwise functions as usual, including deduction of PP. This effect works for disabled moves and ignores Torment.

moves.name: Ion Deluge
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Changes all Pokémon’s Normal moves to Electric moves for the rest of the turn.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.text: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.text: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.text: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Ivy Cudgel
moves.text: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Jaw Lock
moves.text: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.
moves.desc: Inflicts damage, then prevents you and the target from switching out. The user or target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. If they do, the effect ends.

moves.name: Jet Punch
moves.text: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Judgment
moves.text: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. This move's type changes depending on the kind of plate held by the user.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item.

Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

moves.name: Jump Kick
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If this move misses, is blocked by Protect or Detect, or has no effect, the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP rounded down.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

moves.name: Jungle Healing
moves.text: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
moves.desc: Each Pokemon on the user's side has its status condition healed and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded up.

moves.name: Karate Chop
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Kinesis
moves.text: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target’s accuracy.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: King’s Shield
moves.text: The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. It also lowers the Attack stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.
moves.desc: Blocks damaging attacks and lowers attacking Pokémon’s Attack by two stages on contact. Switches Aegislash to Shield Forme.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.text: The user slaps down the target's held item, making it unusable for that battle. This move does more damage if the target has a held item.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle.

If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.

moves.name: Kowtow Cleave
moves.text: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Land’s Wrath
moves.text: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to damage them.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Laser Focus
moves.text: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
moves.desc: The user’s next move will result in a critical hit.

moves.name: Lash Out
moves.text: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.
moves.desc: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.text: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. This move can only be used if each of the user’s other moves has been used at least once since the user entered the field. If this is the user’s only move, this move will fail.

moves.name: Last Respects
moves.text: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Lava Plume
moves.text: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Leaf Blade
moves.text: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and cuts the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.text: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Leaf Tornado
moves.text: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target’s accuracy.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Leafage
moves.text: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Leech Life
moves.text: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.text: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.
moves.desc:
Plants a seed on the target that drains 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn and heals the user for the amount taken. Has no effect on Grass Pokémon. The seed remains until the target leaves the field.

The user takes damage instead of being healed if the target has Liquid Ooze.

Rapid Spin will remove this effect.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Leer
moves.text: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Lick
moves.text: The user licks the target with a long tongue to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Life Dew
moves.text: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
moves.desc: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.text: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.
moves.desc:
Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from special attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier.

If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns.

Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier.

moves.name: Light of Ruin
moves.text: Drawing power from the Eternal Flower, the user fires a powerful beam of light. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/2 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.text: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Lock-On
moves.text: The user takes sure aim at the target. This ensures the user's next move does not miss that target.
moves.desc:
If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit. This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

One-hit KO moves are also guaranteed to hit, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. This effect also allows the user to hit Pokémon that are off the field due to moves such as Dig or Fly.

If the target uses Detect or Protect while under the effect of this move, the user is not guaranteed to hit, but has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Lovely Kiss
moves.text: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.text: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120.

Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120

moves.name: Low Sweep
moves.text: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Lucky Chant
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: For five turns, opposing Pokémon cannot score critical hits.

moves.name: Lumina Crash
moves.text: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Lunar Blessing
moves.text: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

moves.name: Lunar Dance
moves.text: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP and PP restored and its status conditions cured.
moves.desc: User faints. Its replacement’s HP and PP are fully restored, and any major status effect is removed.

moves.name: Lunge
moves.text: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Luster Purge
moves.text: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Mach Punch
moves.text: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Magic Coat
moves.text: Moves like Leech Seed and moves that inflict status conditions are blocked by a barrier and reflected back to the user of those moves.
moves.desc:
The first non-damaging move targeting the user this turn that inflicts major status effects, stat changes, or trapping effects will be reflected at its user.

Defog, Memento, and Teeter Dance are not reflected.

Attract, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Leech Seed, Swagger, Worry Seed, and Yawn are reflected.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Magic Powder
moves.text: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target's type to Psychic.
moves.desc: Causes the target to become a Psychic type. Fails if the target is Arceus, Silvally, or is already only a Psychic type.

moves.name: Magic Room
moves.text: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.
moves.desc: For five turns (including this one), passive effects of held items are ignored, and Pokémon will not use their held items.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.text: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Magma Storm
moves.text: The user traps the target inside a maelstrom of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Magnet Bomb
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Magnet Rise
moves.text: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
moves.desc:
For five turns, the user is immune to Ground moves.

If the user is under the effect of Ingrain or has Levitate, this move will fail.

This effect is temporarily disabled by and cannot be used during Gravity.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Magnetic Flux
moves.text: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus Ability or the Minus Ability.
moves.desc: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.

moves.name: Magnitude
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power is selected at random between 10 and 150, with an average of 71:

Magnitude | Power | Chance --------: | ----: | -----: 4 | 10 | 5% 5 | 30 | 10% 6 | 50 | 20% 7 | 70 | 30% 8 | 90 | 20% 9 | 110 | 10% 10 | 150 | 5%

This move has double power against Pokémon currently underground due to Dig.

moves.name: Make It Rain
moves.text: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.

moves.name: Malignant Chain
moves.text: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

moves.name: Mat Block
moves.text: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves. This does not stop status moves.
moves.desc: Protects all friendly Pokémon from damaging moves. Only works on the first turn after the user is sent out.

moves.name: Matcha Gotcha
moves.text: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Me First
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
If the target has selected a damaging move this turn, the user will copy that move and use it against the target, with a 50% increase in power.

If the target moves before the user, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Mean Look
moves.text: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
moves.desc:
The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field.

The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell.

Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

moves.name: Meditate
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.text: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.text: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.text: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Megahorn
moves.text: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Memento
moves.text: The user faints. In return, the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages. User faints.

moves.name: Metal Burst
moves.text: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
moves.desc: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a damaging move this turn. Inflicts 1.5× the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

moves.name: Metal Claw
moves.text: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also boost the user's Attack stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack one stage.

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.text: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Meteor Assault
moves.text: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can’t move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Meteor Beam
moves.text: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
moves.desc: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Raises the users Special Attack by 1 stage after the first turn.

moves.name: Meteor Mash
moves.text: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. This may also boost the user’s Attack stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack one stage.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.text: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
moves.desc:
Selects any move at random and uses it. Moves the user already knows are not eligible. Assist, meta, protection, and reflection moves are also not eligible; specifically, Assist, Chatter, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Protect, Quick Guard, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, and Wide Guard will not be selected by this move.

This move cannot be copied by Mimic or Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Mighty Cleave
moves.text: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

moves.name: Milk Drink
moves.text: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP.
moves.desc: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.text: The user copies the move last used by the target. The copied move can be used until the user of Mimic leaves the battle.
moves.desc:
This move is replaced by the target’s last successfully used move, and its PP changes to 5. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if the user already knows the targeted move, this move will fail. This effect vanishes when the user leaves the field.

If Chatter, Metronome, Mimic, Sketch, or Struggle is selected, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

moves.name: Mind Blown
moves.text: The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.
moves.desc: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

moves.name: Mind Reader
moves.text: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.
moves.desc:
If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit. This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

One-hit KO moves are also guaranteed to hit, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. This effect also allows the user to hit Pokémon that are off the field due to moves such as Dig or Fly.

If the target uses Detect or Protect while under the effect of this move, the user is not guaranteed to hit, but has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Minimize
moves.text: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply boosts its evasiveness.
moves.desc:
Raises the user’s evasion by two stages.

Stomp and Steamroller have double power against Pokémon that have used this move since entering the field.

moves.name: Miracle Eye
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Mirror Coat
moves.text: A retaliatory attack that counters any special move, inflicting double the damage taken.
moves.desc:
Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a special move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Mirror Move
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Uses the last move targeted at the user by a Pokémon still on the field. A move counts as targeting the user even if it hit multiple Pokémon, as long as the user was one of them; however, moves targeting the field itself do not count. If the user has not been targeted by an appropriate move since entering the field, or if no Pokémon that targeted the user remains on the field, this move will fail.

Moves that failed, missed, had no effect, or were blocked are still copied.

Assist moves, time-delayed moves, “meta” moves that operate on other moves/Pokémon/abilities, and some other special moves cannot be copied and are ignored; if the last move to hit the user was such a move, the previous move will be used instead. The full list of ignored moves is: Acid Armor, Acupressure, After You, Agility, Ally Switch, Amnesia, Aqua Ring, Aromatherapy, Aromatic Mist, Assist, Autotomize, Barrier, Baton Pass, Belch, Belly Drum, Bide, Bulk Up, Calm Mind, Camouflage, Celebrate, Charge, Coil, Conversion, Conversion 2, Copycat, Cosmic Power, Cotton Guard, Counter, Crafty Shield, Curse, Defend Order, Defense Curl, Destiny Bond, Detect, Doom Desire, Double Team, Dragon Dance, Electric Terrain, Endure, Final Gambit, Flower Shield, Focus Energy, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Future Sight, Geomancy, Grassy Terrain, Gravity, Growth, Grudge, Guard Split, Hail, Happy Hour, Harden, Haze, Heal Bell, Heal Order, Heal Pulse, Healing Wish, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, Hone Claws, Howl, Imprison, Ingrain, Ion Deluge, Iron Defense, King’s Shield, Light Screen, Lucky Chant, Lunar Dance, Magic Coat, Magnet Rise, Magnetic Flux, Mat Block, Me First, Meditate, Metronome, Milk Drink, Mimic, Minimize, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Mist, Misty Terrain, Moonlight, Morning Sun, Mud Sport, Nasty Plot, Nature Power, Perish Song, Power Split, Power Trick, Protect, Psych Up, Quick Guard, Quiver Dance, Rage Powder, Rain Dance, Recover, Recycle, Reflect, Reflect Type, Refresh, Rest, Rock Polish, Role Play, Roost, Rototiller, Safeguard, Sandstorm, Shadow Blast, Shadow Bolt, Shadow Half, Shadow Rush, Shadow Shed, Shadow Sky, Shadow Storm, Shadow Wave, Sharpen, Shell Smash, Shift Gear, Sketch, Slack Off, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Soft-Boiled, Spikes, Spiky Shield, Spit Up, Splash, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Stockpile, Struggle, Substitute, Sunny Day, Swallow, Swords Dance, Synthesis, Tail Glow, Tailwind, Teleport, Toxic Spikes, Transform, Water Sport, Wide Guard, Wish, Withdraw and Work Up.

This move cannot be selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk, nor forced by Encore.

moves.name: Mirror Shot
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Mist
moves.text: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.
moves.desc:
Pokémon on the user’s side of the field are immune to stat-lowering effects for five turns.

Guard Swap, Heart Swap, and Power Swap may still be used.

Defog used by an opponent will end this effect.

moves.name: Mist Ball
moves.text: A mist-like flurry of down envelops and damages the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Misty Explosion
moves.text: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.
moves.desc: If Misty Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has its power increased by 50%. Fails if any active Pokemon has the ability Damp.

moves.name: Misty Terrain
moves.text: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.
moves.desc:
For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion and weakens Dragon moves used against them to 0.5× their power.

Changes Nature Power to Moonblast.

moves.name: Moonblast
moves.text: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Moongeist Beam
moves.text: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

moves.name: Moonlight
moves.text: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moves.desc:
Heals the user for half its max HP.

During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

moves.name: Morning Sun
moves.text: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moves.desc:
Heals the user for half its max HP.

During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

moves.name: Mortal Spin
moves.text: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Mountain Gale
moves.text: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Mud Bomb
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.text: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Mud Sport
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Electric moves inflict half damage, regardless of target. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.text: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.text: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Multi-Attack
moves.text: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. The memory held determines the move’s type.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item.

Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

moves.name: Mystical Fire
moves.text: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Mystical Power
moves.text: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.text: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held berry. The berry is consumed. If the user is not holding a berry, this move will fail.

moves.name: Nature Power
moves.text: This attack makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.
moves.desc:
Uses another move chosen according to the terrain.

Terrain | Selected move ------------------------- | ------------------ Building | Tri Attack Cave | Rock Slide Deep water | Hydro Pump Desert | Earthquake Grass | Seed Bomb Mountain | Rock Slide Road | Earthquake Shallow water | Hydro Pump Snow | Blizzard Tall grass | Seed Bomb Electric Terrain | Thunderbolt Grassy Terrain | Energy Ball Misty Terrain | Moonblast

In Pokémon Battle Revolution:

Terrain | Selected move -------------- | ------------------ Courtyard | Tri Attack Crystal | Rock Slide Gateway | Hydro Pump Magma | Rock Slide Main Street | Tri Attack Neon | Tri Attack Stargazer | Rock Slide Sunny Park | Seed Bomb Sunset | Earthquake Waterfall | Seed Bomb

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Nature’s Madness
moves.text: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target’s HP.
moves.desc: Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP.

moves.name: Needle Arm
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Night Daze
moves.text: The user looses a pitch-black shock wave at the target to inflict damage. This may also lower the target's accuracy.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Night Shade
moves.text: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
moves.desc: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.text: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Nightmare
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Only works on sleeping Pokémon. Gives the target a nightmare, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP every turn. If the target wakes up or leaves the field, this effect ends.

moves.name: No Retreat
moves.text: This move boosts all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.
moves.desc: Prevents user from switching out. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. The user or target may switch out using, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the user already has prevented itself from switching by this effect.

moves.name: Noble Roar
moves.text: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Nuzzle
moves.text: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Oblivion Wing
moves.text: The user absorbs its target’s HP. The user’s HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.
moves.desc: Deals regular damage. Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Obstruct
moves.text: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession. Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker’s Defense stat.
moves.desc: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn. If this blocks a contact move, the user has their Defense lowered by 2 stages.

moves.name: Octazooka
moves.text: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face or eyes. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Octolock
moves.text: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. This move also lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def every turn.
moves.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. At the end of each turn, the targets Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. The target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. This effect ends if either Pokemon leave the field.

moves.name: Odor Sleuth
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Ominous Wind
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

moves.name: Order Up
moves.text: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.

moves.name: Origin Pulse
moves.text: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.text: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused.

Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

moves.name: Overdrive
moves.text: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.text: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.text: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.
moves.desc:
Changes the user’s and target’s remaining HP to the average of their current remaining HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect does not count as inflicting damage for other moves and effects that respond to damage taken.

This effect fails against a Substitute.

moves.name: Parabolic Charge
moves.text: The user attacks everything around it. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by those hit.
moves.desc: Heals the user for half the total damage dealt to all targets.

moves.name: Parting Shot
moves.text: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.desc: Lowers all targets’ Attack and Special Attack by one stage. Makes the user switch out.

moves.name: Pay Day
moves.text: Coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. After the battle ends, the winner receives five times the user’s level in extra money for each time this move was used.

moves.name: Payback
moves.text: The user stores power, then attacks. This move's power is doubled if the user moves after the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the target uses a move or switches out this turn before this move is used, this move has double power.

moves.name: Peck
moves.text: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn to inflict damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.text: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
moves.desc:
Every Pokémon is given a counter that starts at 3 and decreases by 1 at the end of every turn, including this one. When a Pokémon’s counter reaches zero, that Pokémon faints. A Pokémon that leaves the field will lose its counter; its replacement does not inherit the effect, and other Pokémon’s counters remain.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Petal Blizzard
moves.text: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Petal Dance
moves.text: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused.

Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

moves.name: Phantom Force
moves.text: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

This move ignores the effects of Detect and Protect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Photon Geyser
moves.text: The user attacks the target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Pika Papow
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.text: The user attacks by shooting sharp spikes at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Plasma Fists
moves.text: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This move changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.
moves.desc: After inflicting damage, all Normal-type moves become Electric-type for the remainder of the turn, including status moves. This effect is applied after move type-changing abilities, such as Pixilate and Normalize.

moves.name: Play Nice
moves.text: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.text: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Pluck
moves.text: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.

If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.

If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

moves.name: Poison Fang
moves.text: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to badly poison the target.

moves.name: Poison Gas
moves.text: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the faces of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those it hits.
moves.desc: Poisons the target.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.text: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.text: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.
moves.desc: Poisons the target.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.text: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Poison Tail
moves.text: The user hits the target with its tail. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also poison the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Pollen Puff
moves.text: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.
moves.desc: If the target is an opponent, inflicts regular damage. If the target is an ally, heals the target for 50% of its max HP.

moves.name: Poltergeist
moves.text: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.
moves.desc: Fails if the target has no held item.

moves.name: Population Bomb
moves.text: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.

moves.name: Pounce
moves.text: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Pound
moves.text: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Powder
moves.text: The user covers the target in a combustible powder. If the target uses a Fire-type move, the powder explodes and damages the target.
moves.desc: Explodes if the target uses a Fire move this turn, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP and preventing the move.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.text: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also leave opposing Pokémon frozen.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.text: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Power Shift
moves.text: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Power Split
moves.text: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.
moves.desc:
Averages the user’s unmodified Attack with the target’s unmodified Attack; the value becomes the unmodified Attack for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Attack is averaged the same way.

This effect applies before any other persistent changes to unmodified Attack or Special Attack, such as Flower Gift during Sunny Day.

moves.name: Power Swap
moves.text: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.
moves.desc: User swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat modifiers modifiers with the target.

moves.name: Power Trick
moves.text: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.
moves.desc:
The user’s original Attack and Defense are swapped.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Power Trip
moves.text: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised. Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power. For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.text: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Power-Up Punch
moves.text: Striking opponents over and over makes the user’s fists harder. Hitting a target raises the Attack stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Precipice Blades
moves.text: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Present
moves.text: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. The gift restores HP sometimes, however.
moves.desc:
Randomly uses one of the following effects.

Effect | Chance -------------------------------------------------- | -----: Inflicts regular damage with 40 power | 40% Inflicts regular damage with 80 power | 30% Inflicts regular damage with 120 power | 10% Heals the target for 1/4 its max HP | 20%

On average, this move inflicts regular damage with 52 power and heals the target for 1/20 its max HP.

moves.name: Prismatic Laser
moves.text: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Protect
moves.text: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.desc:
No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail.

Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move.

Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move.

The following effects are not prevented by this move:

* Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.text: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Psyblade
moves.text: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.text: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
moves.desc:
Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.text: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Psychic Fangs
moves.text: The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
moves.desc: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Psychic Noise
moves.text: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

moves.name: Psychic Terrain
moves.text: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.
moves.desc:
Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns. Overrides Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, and Misty Terrain.

All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0. (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as Spikes, are not affected.) Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a Psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×.

If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.

moves.name: Psycho Boost
moves.text: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.text: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Psycho Shift
moves.text: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status conditions to the target.
moves.desc: If the user has a major status effect and the target does not, the user’s status is transferred to the target.

moves.name: Psyshield Bash
moves.text: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.text: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

moves.name: Psystrike
moves.text: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

moves.name: Psywave
