moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts typeless damage between 50% and 150% of the user’s level, selected at random in increments of 10%.

moves.name: Punishment
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power starts at 60 and is increased by 20 for every stage any of the target’s stats has been raised, capping at 200. Accuracy and evasion modifiers do not increase this move’s power.

moves.name: Purify
moves.text: The user heals the target’s status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user’s own HP.
moves.desc: Cures the target of its major status ailment and heals the user for 50% of its max HP. If the target has no major status ailment, this move will fail.

moves.name: Pursuit
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target attempts to switch out this turn before the user acts, this move hits the target before it leaves and has double power.

This effect can still hit a Pokémon that switches out when it has a Substitute up or when an ally has used Follow Me.

moves.name: Pyro Ball
moves.text: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Quash
moves.text: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
moves.desc: Forces the target to act last this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority. If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.text: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Quick Guard
moves.text: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.
moves.desc:
Moves with priority greater than 0 will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Quiver Dance
moves.text: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

moves.name: Rage
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Every time the user is hit after it uses this move but before its next action, its Attack raises by one stage.

moves.name: Rage Fist
moves.text: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Rage Powder
moves.text: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at the user.
moves.desc:
Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target.

This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain.

If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Raging Bull
moves.text: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Raging Fury
moves.text: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.text: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.
moves.desc:
Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which Water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Fire moves inflict half damage.

If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Thunder has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

Solar Beam has half power.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP.

Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed.

Pokémon with Forecast become Water.

Pokémon with Dry Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.text: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Removes Leech Seed from the user, frees the user from Bind, Clamp, Fire Spin, Magma Storm, Sand Tomb, Whirlpool, and Wrap, and clears Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the user’s side of the field. If this move misses or has no effect, its effect doesn’t activate.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.text: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Razor Shell
moves.text: The user cuts the target with sharp shells to inflict damage. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Razor Wind
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. User charges for one turn before attacking.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Recover
moves.text: The user regenerates its cells, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.
moves.desc: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Recycle
moves.text: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.
moves.desc:
User recovers the last item consumed by the user or a Pokémon in its position on the field. The item must be used again before it can be recovered by this move again. If the user is holding an item, this move fails.

Items taken or given away by Covet, Knock Off, Switcheroo, Thief, or Trick may not be recovered.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.text: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.
moves.desc:
Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from physical attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier.

If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns.

Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier.

moves.name: Reflect Type
moves.text: The user reflects the target's type to become the same type as the target.
moves.desc: User’s type changes to match the target’s.

moves.name: Refresh
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Removes a burn, paralysis, or poison from the user.

moves.name: Relic Song
moves.text: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of the listening opposing Pokémon. This may also induce sleep.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to put the target to sleep. If the user is a Meloetta, it will toggle between Aria and Pirouette Forme.

moves.name: Rest
moves.text: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.
moves.desc:
User falls to sleep and immediately regains all its HP. If the user has another major status effect, sleep will replace it. The user will always wake up after two turns, or one turn with Early Bird.

This move fails if the Pokémon cannot fall asleep due to Uproar, Insomnia, or Vital Spirit. It also fails if the Pokémon is at full health or is already asleep.

moves.name: Retaliate
moves.text: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move's power is boosted if an ally fainted in the previous turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon fainted on the previous turn, this move has double power.

moves.name: Return
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with happiness, given by `happiness * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1.

moves.name: Revelation Dance
moves.text: The user attacks the target by dancing with all its might. This move becomes the same type as the user's type.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. This move’s type matches the user’s first type, if any; otherwise, it’s typeless.

moves.name: Revenge
moves.text: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power.

Pain Split does not count as damaging the user.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.text: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power varies inversely with the user’s proportional remaining HP.

64 * current HP / max HP | Power -----------------------: | ----: 0– 1 | 200 2– 5 | 150 6–12 | 100 13–21 | 80 22–42 | 40 43–64 | 20

moves.name: Revival Blessing
moves.text: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.

moves.name: Rising Voltage
moves.text: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move's power is doubled if the target is on Electric Terrain.
moves.desc: If Electric Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its power doubled.

moves.name: Roar
moves.text: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
moves.desc:
Switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon selected at random. Wild battles end immediately.

Doesn’t affect Pokémon with Suction Cups or under the effect of Ingrain.

moves.name: Roar of Time
moves.text: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.text: The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Rock Climb
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Rock Polish
moves.text: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user's Speed stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.text: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.text: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Rock Throw
moves.text: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to inflict damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.text: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Rock Wrecker
moves.text: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Role Play
moves.text: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's Ability.
moves.desc:
User’s ability is replaced with the target’s until the user leaves the field. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

If the target has Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Stance Change, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Rolling Kick
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.text: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. This attack becomes more powerful each time it hits.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for five turns. Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends. If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends.

If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power.

moves.name: Roost
moves.text: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.
moves.desc: Heals the user for half its max HP. If the user is Flying, its Flying type is ignored until the end of this turn.

moves.name: Rototiller
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all Grass Pokémon in battle.

moves.name: Round
moves.text: The user attacks the target with a song. If others use this move, they will act immediately after the initial user, and the power of their Rounds will be boosted.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If Round has already been used this turn, this move’s power is doubled. After this move is used, any other Pokémon using it this turn will immediately do so (in the order they would otherwise act), regardless of Speed or priority. Pokémon using other moves will then continue to act as usual.

moves.name: Ruination
moves.text: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

moves.name: Sacred Fire
moves.text: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

moves.name: Sacred Sword
moves.text: The user attacks by slicing with a sword. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.text: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.
moves.desc:
Protects Pokémon on the user’s side of the field from major status effects and confusion for five turns. Does not cancel existing ailments. This effect remains even if the user leaves the field.

If Yawn is used while this move is in effect, it will immediately fail.

Defog used by an opponent will end this effect.

This effect does not prevent the confusion caused by Outrage, Petal Dance, or Thrash.

moves.name: Salt Cure
moves.text: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.text: Sand is hurled in the target's face, lowering the target's accuracy.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Sand Tomb
moves.text: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Sandsear Storm
moves.text: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.text: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.
moves.desc:
Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns. Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect.

Solar Beam’s power is halved.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP.

moves.name: Sappy Seed
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Scald
moves.text: The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Scale Shot
moves.text: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage two to five times in a row, raising the user’s Speed and lowering the user’s Defense by one stage each upon last hit.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.text: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Scorching Sands
moves.text: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.text: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Screech
moves.text: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Searing Shot
moves.text: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to inflict an effect chosen according to the terrain.

Terrain | Effect -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- Building | Paralyzes target Cave | Makes target flinch Deep water | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Desert | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Grass | Puts target to sleep Mountain | Makes target flinch Road | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Shallow water | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Snow | Freezes target Tall grass | Puts target to sleep

In Pokémon Battle Revolution:

Terrain | Effect -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- Courtyard | Paralyzes target Crystal | Makes target flinch Gateway | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Magma | Makes target flinch Main Street | Paralyzes target Neon | Paralyzes target Stargazer | Makes target flinch Sunny Park | Puts target to sleep Sunset | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Waterfall | Puts target to sleep

moves.name: Secret Sword
moves.text: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in the horn deals physical damage to the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.text: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Seed Flare
moves.text: The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. This may also harshly lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Seismic Toss
moves.text: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
moves.desc: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.text: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
moves.desc: User faints, even if the attack fails or misses. Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.text: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Shadow Bone
moves.text: The user attacks by beating the target with a bone that contains a spirit. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.text: The user attacks by slashing the target with a sharp claw made from shadows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Shadow Force
moves.text: The user disappears on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

This move ignores the effects of Detect and Protect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Shadow Punch
moves.text: The user throws a punch from the shadows. This attack never misses.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Shadow Sneak
moves.text: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Sharpen
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Shed Tail
moves.text: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.text: The target faints instantly. This move is less likely to hit the target if used by Pokémon other than Ice types.
moves.desc:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

moves.name: Shell Side Arm
moves.text: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This may also poison the target.
moves.desc: Has a chance to poison the target. This switches categories between physical and special, depending on which would deal more damage to the target. If the damage is tied, it is randomly chosen. This calculation ignores any modifiers other than stat stages.

moves.name: Shell Smash
moves.text: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages each. Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Shell Trap
moves.text: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode and inflict damage on opposing Pokémon.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the user was not yet hit by an opponent’s physical move this turn, this move will fail.

moves.name: Shelter
moves.text: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Shift Gear
moves.text: The user rotates its gears, boosting its Attack stat and sharply boosting its Speed stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage and its Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.text: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Shore Up
moves.text: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP in a sandstorm.
moves.desc: Heals the user for ½ its max HP. During a Sandstorm, the healing is increased to ⅔.

moves.name: Signal Beam
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Silk Trap
moves.text: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

moves.name: Silver Wind
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

moves.name: Simple Beam
moves.text: The user emits a mysterious psychic wave that changes the target's Ability to Simple.
moves.desc: Changes the target’s ability to Simple.

moves.name: Sing
moves.text: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Sizzly Slide
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Sketch
moves.text: This move enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.
moves.desc:
Permanently replaces itself with the target’s last used move. If that move is Chatter or Struggle, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mimic or Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.text: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.
moves.desc:
User and target switch abilities. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

If either Pokémon has Multitype or Wonder Guard, this move will fail.

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.text: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Skull Bash
moves.text: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Defense by one stage. User then charges for one turn before attacking.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Sky Attack
moves.text: The user attacks the turn after using this move. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. Critical hit chance is one level higher than normal. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Sky Drop
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User carries the target high into the air for one turn, during which no moves will hit either Pokémon and neither can act. On the following turn, the user drops the target, inflicting damage and ending the effect.

If the target is Flying-type, this move will function as normal but inflict no damage.

Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, Twister, and Whirlwind can hit both the user and the target during this effect. Gust and Twister will additionally have double power.

The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during this effect.

Either Pokémon may be hit during this effect if also under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

*Bug*: If Gravity is used during a double or triple battle while this move is in effect, this move is not correctly canceled on the target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely. As this move prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

moves.name: Sky Uppercut
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage.

This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop.

moves.name: Slack Off
moves.text: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.
moves.desc: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Slam
moves.text: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Slash
moves.text: The target is attacked with a slash of claws, scythes, or the like. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.text: The user scatters a cloud of soporific dust that puts the target to sleep.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.text: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.
moves.desc:
Only usable if the user is sleeping. Randomly selects and uses one of the user’s other three moves. Use of the selected move requires and costs 0 PP.

This move will not select Assist, Bide, Bounce, Chatter, Copycat, Dig, Dive, Fly, Focus Punch, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, Shadow Force, Skull Bash, Sky Attack, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Solar Beam, Razor Wind, or Uproar.

If the selected move requires a recharge turn—i.e., one of Blast Burn, Frenzy Plant, Giga Impact, Hydro Cannon, Hyper Beam, Roar of Time, or Rock Wrecker—and the user is still sleeping next turn, then it’s forced to use this move again and pay another PP for the recharge turn.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Sludge
moves.text: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.text: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Sludge Wave
moves.text: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those it hits.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Smack Down
moves.text: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. If the target is in the air, it will be knocked down to the ground.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Removes the target’s immunity to Ground-type damage. This effect removes any existing Ground immunity due to Levitate, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, and causes the target’s Flying type to be ignored when it takes Ground damage.

If the target isn’t immune to Ground damage, this move will fail.

This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, and ends the effect of Bounce or Fly.

moves.name: Smart Strike
moves.text: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Smelling Salts
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is paralyzed, this move has double power, and the target is cured of its paralysis.

moves.name: Smog
moves.text: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This may also poison the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Smokescreen
moves.text: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target's accuracy.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Snap Trap
moves.text: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.text: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
The next time a Pokémon uses a beneficial move on itself or itself and its ally this turn, the user of this move will steal the move and use it itself. Moves which may be stolen by this move are identified by the "snatchable" flag.

If two Pokémon use this move on the same turn, the faster Pokémon will steal the first beneficial move, and the slower Pokémon will then steal it again—thus, only the slowest Pokémon using this move ultimately gains a stolen move’s effect.

If the user steals Psych Up, it will target the Pokémon that used Psych Up. If the user was the original target of Psych Up, and the Pokémon that originally used it’s affected by Pressure, it will only lose 1 PP.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Snipe Shot
moves.text: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.
moves.desc: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

moves.name: Snore
moves.text: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Only usable if the user is sleeping. Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Snowscape
moves.text: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

moves.name: Soak
moves.text: The user shoots a torrent of water that changes the target's type to Water.
moves.desc: Changes the target to pure Water-type until it leaves the field. If the target has Multitype, this move will fail.

moves.name: Soft-Boiled
moves.text: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP.
moves.desc: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.text: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking.

During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Solar Blade
moves.text: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light's energy and attacks on the next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking.

During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Sonic Boom
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts exactly 20 damage.

moves.name: Spacial Rend
moves.text: The user tears the target along with the space around it. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Spark
moves.text: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Sparkling Aria
moves.text: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be cured by the touch of these bubbles.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has a burn and takes damage from this move, its burn is healed.

moves.name: Sparkly Swirl
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Spectral Thief
moves.text: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.
moves.desc: Steals the target’s stat increases, then inflicts regular damage. Will not steal stat increases that would put any of the user’s stats at more than +6; any excess is left on the target. Stolen increases are affected by abilities as normal.

moves.name: Speed Swap
moves.text: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
moves.desc: Exchanges the original Speed stats of the user and target.

moves.name: Spicy Extract
moves.text: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Spider Web
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field.

The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell.

Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

moves.name: Spike Cannon
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.text: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
moves.desc:
Scatters spikes around the opposing field, which damage opposing Pokémon that enter the field for 1/8 of their max HP. Pokémon immune to Ground moves are immune to this damage, except during Gravity. Up to three layers of spikes may be laid down, adding 1/16 to the damage done: two layers of spikes damage for 3/16 max HP, and three layers damage for 1/4 max HP.

Wonder Guard does not block damage from this effect.

Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog removes this effect from its target’s side of the field.

moves.name: Spiky Shield
moves.text: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker that makes direct contact.
moves.desc: Blocks damaging attacks and damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP.

moves.name: Spin Out
moves.text: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Spirit Break
moves.text: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Spirit Shackle
moves.text: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target's shadow to the ground to prevent the target from fleeing.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target.

moves.name: Spit Up
moves.text: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move's power.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power is equal to 100 times the amount of energy stored by Stockpile. Ignores the random factor in the damage formula. Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used. If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Spite
moves.text: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.
moves.desc: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail.

moves.name: Splash
moves.text: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...
moves.desc:
Does nothing.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

moves.name: Splishy Splash
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Spore
moves.text: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Spotlight
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: For the duration of the turn, if the target is also a valid target for a move used by one of its opponents, that move will target it instead.

moves.name: Springtide Storm
moves.text: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.text: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
moves.desc:
Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP. This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to Rock moves.

Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field.

moves.name: Steam Eruption
moves.text: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Steamroller
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Power is doubled against Pokémon that have used Minimize since entering the field.

moves.name: Steel Beam
moves.text: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.
moves.desc: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.text: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.
moves.desc: Ends the effect of Electric, Grassy, Misty, or Psychic Terrains. Fails if no Terrain is active.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.text: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also boost the user's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense one stage.

moves.name: Sticky Web
moves.text: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching into battle.
moves.desc:
Shoots a web over the opponents’ side of the field, which lowers the Speed of any opposing Pokémon that enters the field by one stage.

Pokémon in the air, such as Flying-types and those with Levitate, are unaffected. Rapid Spin removes Sticky Web from the user’s side of the field; Defog removes it from both sides.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.text: The user stores power and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to three times.
moves.desc:
Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each. Stores energy for use with Spit Up and Swallow. Up to three levels of energy can be stored, and all are lost if the user leaves the field. Energy is still stored even if the stat boosts cannot be applied.

If the user uses Baton Pass, the stat boosts are passed as normal, but the stored energy is not.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.text: The user attacks by stomping on the target with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Power is doubled against Pokémon that have used Minimize since entering the field.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.text: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power is doubled if the user’s last move failed for any reason (i.e., produced the message "But it failed!") or was ineffective due to types.

moves.name: Stone Axe
moves.text: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.text: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.text: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised. Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power. For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.

moves.name: Storm Throw
moves.text: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit.

moves.name: Strange Steam
moves.text: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Strength
moves.text: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Strength Sap
moves.text: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It then lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.desc:
Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage. Heals the user by the target’s current Attack, including modifiers, but not including this move’s Attack-lowering effect.

If the target’s Attack is already at -6, this move will fail. In any other situation that would prevent a stat modification, the healing will still succeed.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.text: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Struggle
moves.text: This attack is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It also damages the user a little.
moves.desc:
Inflicts typeless regular damage. User takes 1/4 its max HP in recoil. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

This move is used automatically when a Pokémon cannot use any other move legally, e.g., due to having no PP remaining or being under the effect of both Encore and Torment at the same time.

This move’s recoil is not treated as recoil for the purposes of anything that affects recoil, such as the ability Rock Head. It also is not prevented by Magic Guard.

This move cannot be copied by Mimic, Mirror Move, or Sketch, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.text: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Stuff Cheeks
moves.text: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.
moves.desc: This move cannot be used unless the user is holding a berry. The user consumes a berry, activates its effects, and raises its defense by 2 stages. This effect works even if Embargo or Magic Room are in effect.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.text: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.
moves.desc: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Submission
moves.text: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. This also damages the user a little.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.text: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.
moves.desc:
Transfers 1/4 the user’s max HP into a doll that absorbs damage and causes most negative move effects to fail. If the user leaves the field, the doll will vanish. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail.

The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero. Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move.

The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate.

Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal.

It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep.

The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked.

Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll.

The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes.

The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation.

All other effects work as normal.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.text: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target has not selected a damaging move this turn, or if the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

This move is not affected by Iron Fist.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.text: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.
moves.desc:
Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage.

If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Pokémon cannot become frozen.

Thunder has 50% accuracy.

Solar Beam skips its charge turn.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP.

Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed.

Pokémon with Forecast become Fire.

Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects.

Pokémon with Flower Gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%.

Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn.

Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.

moves.name: Sunsteel Strike
moves.text: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.text: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.
moves.desc: Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP.

moves.name: Supercell Slam
moves.text: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.text: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.text: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.
moves.desc: Confuses the target.

moves.name: Surf
moves.text: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: Surging Strikes
moves.text: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.
moves.desc: Hits three times. Always scores a critical hit.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.text: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.
moves.desc: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages, then confuses it. If the target’s Attack cannot be raised by two stages, the confusion is not applied.

moves.name: Swallow
moves.text: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.
moves.desc: Heals the user depending on the amount of energy stored by Stockpile: 1/4 its max HP after one use, 1/2 its max HP after two uses, or fully after three uses. Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used. If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.

moves.name: Sweet Kiss
moves.text: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.
moves.desc: Confuses the target.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.text: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.

moves.name: Swift
moves.text: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Switcheroo
moves.text: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.
moves.desc:
User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail.

If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail.

If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.text: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Synchronoise
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Only Pokémon that share a type with the user will take damage from this move.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.text: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moves.desc:
Heals the user for half its max HP.

During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

moves.name: Syrup Bomb
moves.text: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.

moves.name: Tachyon Cutter
moves.text: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.text: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Tail Glow
moves.text: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically boosting its Sp. Atk stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Special Attack by three stages.

moves.name: Tail Slap
moves.text: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.text: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Defense stats.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.text: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.
moves.desc: For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user’s side of the field have their original Speed doubled. This effect remains if the user leaves the field.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.text: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Take Heart
moves.text: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Tar Shot
moves.text: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.
moves.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.text: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.
moves.desc:
Target is forced to only use damaging moves for the next 3–5 turns, selected at random. Moves that select other moves not known in advance do not count as damaging.

Assist, Copycat, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, and Sleep Talk do not directly inflict damage and thus may not be used.

Bide, Counter, Endeavor, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat are allowed.

moves.name: Tearful Look
moves.text: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

moves.name: Teatime
moves.text: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
moves.desc: All Pokemon on the field consume their held berries. This effect is not prevented by Substitute, Embargo, Magic Room, Klutz, or Unnerve. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a berry.

moves.name: Techno Blast
moves.text: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The move’s type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item.

Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.text: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses every Pokémon around it.
moves.desc: Confuses all targets.

moves.name: Telekinesis
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
For three turns (including this one), moves used against the target have 100% accuracy, but the target is immune to Ground damage. Accuracy of one-hit KO moves is exempt from this effect.

This effect is removed by Gravity. If Gravity is already in effect, this move will fail.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.text: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, if any. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.
moves.desc: Does nothing. Wild battles end immediately.

moves.name: Temper Flare
moves.text: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.text: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Tera Starstorm
moves.text: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Terrain Pulse
moves.text: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.
moves.desc: If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type.

moves.name: Thief
moves.text: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken.

Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect.

The target cannot recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Thousand Arrows
moves.text: This move also hits opposing Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Grounds the target until it leaves battle. Ignores levitation effects and the immunity of Flying-type Pokémon.

moves.name: Thousand Waves
moves.text: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those it hits can’t flee from battle.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.text: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused.

Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.text: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Silences the target for two turns, preventing it from using any sound-based moves.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.text: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.

moves.name: Thunder Cage
moves.text: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.text: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.text: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.text: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.text: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.
moves.desc: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.text: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Thunderclap
moves.text: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

moves.name: Thunderous Kick
moves.text: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Tickle
moves.text: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Tidy Up
moves.text: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

moves.name: Topsy-Turvy
moves.text: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.
moves.desc: Inverts the target’s stat modifiers.

moves.name: Torch Song
moves.text: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Torment
moves.text: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
moves.desc:
Prevents the target from attempting to use the same move twice in a row. When the target leaves the field, this effect ends.

If the target is forced to attempt a repeated move due to Choice Band, Choice Scarf, Choice Specs, Disable, Encore, Taunt, only having PP remaining for one move, or any other effect, the target will use Struggle instead. The target is then free to use the forced move next turn, as it didn’t use that move this turn.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.text: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
moves.desc: Badly poisons the target. Never misses when used by a Poison-type Pokémon.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.text: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
moves.desc:
Scatters poisoned spikes around the opposing field, which poison opposing Pokémon that enter the field. A second layer of these spikes may be laid down, in which case Pokémon will be badly poisoned instead. Pokémon immune to either Ground moves or being poisoned are immune to this effect. Pokémon otherwise immune to Ground moves are affected during Gravity.

If a Poison Pokémon not immune to Ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed.

Rapid Spin will remove this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog will remove this effect from its target’s side of the field.

This move does not trigger Synchronize, unless the Pokémon with Synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as Roar.

Pokémon entering the field due to Baton Pass are not affected by this effect.

moves.name: Toxic Thread
moves.text: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.
moves.desc: Poisons the target and lowers its Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Trailblaze
moves.text: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Transform
moves.text: The user transforms into a copy of the target, right down to having the same move set.
moves.desc:
User copies the target’s species, weight, type, ability, calculated stats (except HP), and moves. Copied moves will all have 5 PP remaining. IVs are copied for the purposes of Hidden Power, but stats are not recalculated.

Choice Band, Choice Scarf, and Choice Specs stay in effect, and the user must select a new move.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor forced by Encore.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.text: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn, freeze, or paralyze the target. One of these effects is selected at random; they do not each have independent chances to occur.

moves.name: Trick
moves.text: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.
moves.desc:
User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail.

If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail.

If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.text: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
moves.desc:
For five turns (including this one), slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon. Move priority is not affected. Using this move when its effect is already active will end the effect.

Pokémon holding Full Incense, Lagging Tail, or Quick Claw and Pokémon with Stall ignore this effect.

moves.name: Trick-or-Treat
moves.text: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target’s type.
moves.desc: Adds Ghost to the target’s types.

moves.name: Triple Arrows
moves.text: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.

moves.name: Triple Axel
moves.text: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits three times in the same turn. The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power. Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses.

Skill Link does not apply.

moves.name: Triple Dive
moves.text: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

moves.name: Triple Kick
moves.text: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits three times in the same turn. The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power. Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses.

Skill Link does not apply.

moves.name: Trop Kick
moves.text: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Trump Card
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power is determined by the PP remaining for this move, after its PP cost is deducted. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

PP remaining | Power ------------ | ----: 4 or more | 40 3 | 50 2 | 60 1 | 80 0 | 200

If this move is activated by another move, the activating move’s PP is used to calculate power.

moves.name: Twin Beam
moves.text: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Twineedle
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in the same turn. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Twister
moves.text: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make each target flinch.

If the target is under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

moves.name: Upper Hand
moves.text: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.text: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for 2–5 turns, selected at random. All Pokémon on the field wake up, and none can fall to sleep until the lock-in ends.

Pokémon cannot use Rest during this effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: V-create
moves.text: With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself at its target. This lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the user’s Defense, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.text: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Veevee Volley
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Venom Drench
moves.text: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.text: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is poisoned, this move has double power.

moves.name: Victory Dance
moves.text: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.text: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Vise Grip
moves.text: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Vital Throw
moves.text: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used.
