This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

moves.name: Volt Tackle
moves.text: The user electrifies itself and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Wake-Up Slap
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is sleeping, this move has double power, and the target wakes up.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.text: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Water Pledge
moves.text: A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a rainbow appears.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Grass Pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon have halved Speed for four turns (including this one).

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.text: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Water Shuriken
moves.text: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times.

moves.name: Water Sport
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Fire moves inflict half damage, regardless of target. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.text: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.text: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Wave Crash
moves.text: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.text: This move's type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If a weather move is active, this move has double power, and its type becomes the type of the weather move. Shadow Sky is typeless for the purposes of this move.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.text: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.text: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
moves.desc:
Switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon selected at random. Wild battles end immediately.

Doesn’t affect Pokémon with Suction Cups or under the effect of Ingrain.

moves.name: Wicked Blow
moves.text: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit.

moves.name: Wide Guard
moves.text: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.
moves.desc:
Moves with multiple targets will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.text: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Wildbolt Storm
moves.text: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.text: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.
moves.desc: Burns the target.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.text: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Wish
moves.text: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.
moves.desc: At the end of the next turn, user will be healed for half its max HP. If the user is switched out, its replacement will be healed instead for half of the user’s max HP. If the user faints or is forcefully switched by Roar or Whirlwind, this effect will not activate.

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.text: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Wonder Room
moves.text: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.
moves.desc: For five turns (including this one), every Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.text: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Work Up
moves.text: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.text: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.
moves.desc:
Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.

If the target’s ability is Truant or Multitype, this move will fail.

moves.name: Wrap
moves.text: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Wring Out
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.text: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.text: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.
moves.desc:
Puts the target to sleep at the end of the next turn. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If the target leaves the field, this effect is canceled. If the target has a status effect when this move is used, this move will fail.

If the target is protected by Safeguard when this move is used, this move will fail.

Insomnia and Vital Spirit prevent the sleep if the target has either at the end of the next turn, but will not cause this move to fail on use.

moves.name: Zap Cannon
moves.text: The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.text: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Zing Zap
moves.text: The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Zippy Zap
moves.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.
